summary: Dyne Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose a Second Amendment to its existing Loan and Security Agreement with Hercules Capital. The amendment expands the debt facility to $400 million by adding two new tranches of $50 million each and increasing the final tranche by $25 million. The company borrowed an initial $50 million tranche at closing, bringing outstanding principal to $200 million. The amendment also reduces the minimum cash covenant from 60% to 40% of outstanding obligations and pushes the initial testing date from January 1, 2027 to July 1, 2027, extendable to July 1, 2028. Interest accrues at Prime plus 2.45% (floor 7.50%), with maturity on July 1, 2030. This is a routine debt facility modification, not a special situation.
